title: Agaci spa at Grand Hyatt Deer Valley reopens with a facelift - Park Record
content:
The Agaci Spa and Wellness center at the Grand Hyatt Deer Valley has expanded with amenities like a lounge for spa visitors. Credit: Photo courtesy of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley [...] Credit: Photo courtesy of Grand Hyatt Deer Valley

 

A cold shower room is part of the expanded Agaci Spa and Wellness, which, paired with a dry sauna, allows guests to experiment with contrast therapy.

As a longtime spa industry professional, Codrington said having spa amenities beyond a treatment menu is essential to the mission of a wellness center. [...] When construction began on the Grand Hyatt Deer Valley, a spa center wasn’t in the plans. But the owners, quickly realizing the need for a wellness option, converted an area planned for hotel rooms into treatment rooms, hired trained staff and opened Agaci Spa and Wellness, named for the “hayat ağacı,” the Tree of Life.

For the first year, the spa had a treatment menu of facials and massages but no guest facility area. So this summer, they built one.
